title: Chapter 134 — Post-Sale Follow-Up
intro: The sale does not end at delivery.

sections.title: The Follow-Up Cadence
sections.content:
Delivery day check-in: 'Hi [name], just checking that everything went smoothly with your delivery today.' 48-hour call: 'How is the new dishwasher working? Any questions about features or settings?' This call catches problems early, before they become complaints.

One-week follow-up for complex installations — ranges with gas connections, built-in refrigeration with panel work. 30-day check-in: 'Everything still running great? By the way, if you know anyone shopping for appliances, I would love the chance to help them.'

sections.title: Asking for Reviews
sections.content:
The best window for asking is 48 hours to one week after delivery. The customer is excited about their new appliance. Satisfaction is at its peak.

'Would you mind leaving a quick review? It helps our store and it helps me personally.' Include a direct link to the Google review page. Make it as easy as one click.

sections.title: Most Stores Stop Here
sections.content:
Most stores ignore the customer after the truck leaves. The ones that do not build empires. Your post-sale follow-up system is what separates a $60K career from a $120K career.

Every follow-up call is a retention touchpoint. Every check-in is a referral opportunity. Every resolved issue is a loyalty deposit. The customers you follow up with become the customers who follow you.
